bio: A criminal turned bounty hunter, it's Benkoro's job to bring back fugitives who think fleeing into the Voidscar is a sureshot to freedom. By the time Benkoro finds them, usually after a harrowing Demon encounter, they're begging to be ensnared in the spiky embrace of his shackleclub and dragged back to the Broken Reach.
